clue.text: False claim he made to be tsar

indicators.note: a false claim is a made-up one, so these letters are reworked into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: An impostor pretends to the Russian throne on a lying claim.
explanation.walkthrough: 'False' signals an anagram of CLAIM HE; 'made to be' just links wordplay to definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Michael Romanov was the first of the Romanov dynasty to rule Russia as tsar, so the name fits a tsar.

clue.text: Unassuming, as Mussorgsky was

definitions.meaning: the Russian composer's first name was ...

explanation.definitionFit: Being humble about one's merits is the core sense, and Mussorgsky's forename gives the second reading.

clue.text: Back of chair used in clubs, luxurious and well-padded

parts.note: C is the abbreviation for clubs in card games

indicators.note: used in says that letter goes inside the pieces that follow

parts.note: opulent means rich and luxurious

indicators.note: the back of a word is its final letter

explanation.surface: A plush, well-upholstered chair back in a gentlemen's club.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Back of' gives R, which 'used in' puts between C and OPULENT.
explanation.definitionFit: Well-padded is a jocular way of saying fat, and corpulent means stout or overweight.

clue.text: Put in fish that's going rotten

parts.note: to add is to put something in
a ling is a long food fish of the cod family

explanation.surface: Someone adds a fish to a dish that is going off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'that's' simply links wordplay to definition.
explanation.definitionFit: An egg that addles goes bad, so addling means spoiling or turning putrid.

clue.text: Pet need of striker in union?

parts.note: love is an endearment like pet, as in 'thanks, love'
a match is what a striker, the rough strip on a matchbox, needs

explanation.surface: A striking trade unionist's needs are pampered.
explanation.walkthrough: 'striker' suggests a worker on strike in a union, but here is the strip a match is struck on. 'in' links.
explanation.definitionFit: A marriage made for affection rather than money or status is described this way, so the hyphenated phrase is a kind of marriage.

clue.text: Fail to go off and produce a report

definitions.text: Fail to go off and produce a report

parts.words: Fail to go off and produce a report
parts.note: reads like an office worker shirking a write-up, but a report is the bang of a gun that fails to discharge

explanation.walkthrough: A 'report' is the bang a firearm makes; a gun that does not go off makes none.
explanation.definitionFit: When a gun's cartridge fails to ignite, the shot does not happen, which is exactly a failure to discharge with a bang.

clue.text: Fruit produced by bishops, perhaps, outside see

indicators.note: outside says the chess pieces go round the next letters

parts.note: bishops are chess pieces, also called men
lo is an old word for look or see

explanation.surface: Clergymen around a cathedral see grow fruit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'see' looks like a bishop's diocese but is LO, behold. 'produced by' links.
explanation.definitionFit: A melon is a large round fruit with sweet juicy flesh, such as a cantaloupe.

clue.text: Cardinal takes drink with military men

parts.note: to sup is to drink in small mouthfuls
REME is the Royal Electrical and Mechanical Engineers, a British Army corps

explanation.surface: A churchman has a drink with soldiers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cardinal' suggests a churchman but is the adjective meaning principal. 'takes' links.
explanation.definitionFit: Cardinal as an adjective means of chief importance, so greatest or highest.

clue.text: Northerner's home game — soldier turned up first

indicators.note: first says the soldier comes before the game
turned up in a down clue means the soldier's letters are read upwards

parts.note: GI is an American soldier
loo is an old card game

explanation.surface: An Arctic dweller's house game, with a soldier arriving first.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'turned up' means read upwards; 'first' places the soldier ahead of the game. Loo is an old card game, not the lavatory here.
explanation.definitionFit: An igloo is a dome of snow blocks, the traditional dwelling of the Inuit in the far north.

clue.text: Like taped music some remember as a blessing

indicators.note: some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Some people remember recorded music fondly.
explanation.definitionFit: Music on magnetic tape can be wiped and recorded over, so it is removable.

clue.text: Reckless prosecutor about to take on junior counsel

parts.note: DA is a district attorney, a US public prosecutor
RE means about or concerning
in English law a devil is a junior barrister who does work for a senior one

explanation.surface: A rash prosecutor is about to hire a junior barrister.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to take on' joins the pieces; a DEVIL in British legal slang is a junior barrister doing work for a senior one.
explanation.definitionFit: A daredevil is someone who takes wild risks, so as an adjective it means rash or heedless.

clue.text: A president's first dance

indicators.note: first says the president's name comes before the A rather than after it

parts.note: James Polk was the eleventh US president

explanation.surface: A US president leads off the first dance at a ball.
explanation.walkthrough: 'first' tells you the president goes before A, though A is printed earlier.
explanation.definitionFit: The polka is a lively Bohemian couple dance in two-four time.

clue.text: Arab's son mainly employed in sound reproduction

indicators.note: mainly means most but not all of the word, so its last letter is lost

parts.note: audio is the reproduction of sound, as in audio equipment

explanation.surface: An Arab's son works mostly in hi-fi.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mainly' drops the final O of AUDIO; 'employed in' is linking, and the definition reads 'Arab is'.
explanation.definitionFit: A Saudi is a native of Saudi Arabia, so is an Arab.

clue.text: Northern state nominates new assembly

indicators.note: a new assembly of the letters puts them together in a fresh order

explanation.surface: A northern state puts up candidates for a new legislative assembly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'new assembly' looks like a parliament but signals rearranging NOMINATES.
explanation.definitionFit: Minnesota is a US state on the Canadian border, in the far north of the country.

clue.text: Certain people display shock after crew's dance

indicators.note: after says the other pieces follow the crew's word

parts.note: a rowing eight is a crew, and the 's is read as 'is', giving eight's
some means certain people, as in 'some say'
to reel is to stagger back from a blow or a shock

explanation.surface: Some onlookers are shocked by what a rowing crew gets up to.
explanation.walkthrough: 'after' places the certain people and the shock behind the crew, though the clue prints them first. A rowing eight is the crew.
explanation.definitionFit: An eightsome reel is a Scottish country dance for eight people.

clue.text: Money collected from party member without hesitation

indicators.note: without means outside, here standing beside the party member on the far side

parts.note: off means from, as in take it off him
er is the sound of someone hesitating
a Tory is a member of the UK Conservative Party

explanation.surface: A party member hands over money without hesitating.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' reads as lacking but here means outside, with the hesitation standing beside the party member at its front.
explanation.definitionFit: The offertory is the collection of money from the congregation during a church service.

clue.text: River worker secures share of profits as performer

indicators.note: secures says the river and worker hold the share between them

parts.note: the Exe is a river in Devon
an ant is the classic worker insect
a cut is a share of the takings

explanation.surface: A river worker gets a share of the profits for performing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'secures' reads as a river worker locking something up but means holding the share between the two pieces; 'as' links. The Exe is in Devon.
explanation.definitionFit: An executant is someone who carries out a performance, especially a musician.

clue.text: Spies act strangely, retreating from reality

indicators.note: strangely says these letters are to be read in an odd order

explanation.surface: Spies behave oddly, withdrawing from the real world.
explanation.definitionFit: Escapist describes seeking distraction in fantasy to avoid the unpleasant facts of life.

clue.text: Remain neutral, or restrain the criminal?

definitions.meaning: to stay undecided between two sides in a dispute
a fence is a receiver of stolen goods, so to hold one down by sitting on him

explanation.walkthrough: A 'fence' is criminal slang for someone who buys and sells stolen goods; the question mark marks this whimsical second reading.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom pictures someone perched on a boundary, belonging to neither field, refusing to take a side.

clue.text: One joining alliance with partners in communities

indicators.note: joining says the one goes in among the alliance letters

parts.note: NATO is the North Atlantic Treaty Organisation, a military alliance
one is the Roman numeral I
N and S, North and South, are partners at bridge

explanation.surface: A country joins an alliance with its partners in communities.
explanation.walkthrough: 'joining' puts I into NATO; NS is the North-South partnership at bridge. 'with' and 'in' link.
explanation.definitionFit: Nations are peoples united by shared history and territory, so communities on a large scale.

clue.text: Time in special cell — but one isn't charged

indicators.note: in says the time letter goes inside the cell word

parts.note: a neuron is a nerve cell, a specialised kind of cell

explanation.surface: A prisoner serves time in a special cell, though not charged.
explanation.walkthrough: 'charged' suggests a prisoner but means electrically charged. 'but' links.
explanation.definitionFit: The neutron is the subatomic particle with no electric charge.

clue.text: Excellent food brought in for each person

indicators.note: brought in says the food is placed inside the word for excellent

parts.note: ace means excellent
a pie is a kind of food

explanation.surface: Excellent food is served to every guest.
explanation.definitionFit: Apiece means each, as in a pound apiece, a share to every individual.

clue.text: Stimulating foretaste of cooked tripe and peas

indicators.note: cooked suggests the ingredients are worked up into something else, so their letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A dish of tripe and peas is served as the starter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cooked' rearranges TRIPE and PEAS together; 'of' and 'and' are links.
explanation.definitionFit: An appetiser is a small dish before the main meal, giving a taste of what is to come and sharpening hunger.

clue.text: Seafood pie originally served fresh before noon

indicators.note: originally means at the origin, so the word's first letter

parts.note: raw means fresh and uncooked

explanation.surface: A seafood pie is first served fresh before midday.
explanation.walkthrough: 'served' and 'before' link the pieces, already in order.
explanation.definitionFit: A prawn is a small shellfish eaten as seafood.

clue.text: Goody-goody appearing in main drawing

indicators.note: appearing in says the goody-goody sits inside the main word

parts.note: the main is a poetic word for the sea
pi is short for pious, a goody-goody

explanation.surface: A prig turns up in the chief drawing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'main' looks like an adjective but is the open sea.
explanation.definitionFit: A sepia is a brown-toned drawing or photograph, named after the cuttlefish ink.

clue.text: Wrongfully seize old city, captured by American power

indicators.note: captured by says the old city sits inside the pieces that follow

parts.note: US is short for American, as in US forces
P is the physics symbol for power
Ur was an ancient city of Mesopotamia

explanation.surface: An American power seizes an ancient city unlawfully.
explanation.walkthrough: 'captured by' puts the ancient Mesopotamian city between the American and the power letters.
explanation.definitionFit: To usurp is to take a position or power by force without right.

clue.text: Mature insect a long way back in the past

indicators.note: back says the letters for the long way are written in reverse

parts.note: MI is short for mile, a long way to walk
ago means in the past, as in long ago

explanation.surface: An adult insect from a long way back in history.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' turns MI to IM; the surface makes 'a long way back' one phrase about time.
explanation.definitionFit: The imago is the final, adult stage in an insect's metamorphosis, after the larva and pupa.

clue.text: Idle talk's holding back queen with company, sire

indicators.note: holding says the chatter word wraps round what follows

parts.note: prate is idle chatter, and the 's is read as 'is'

indicators.note: back says the queen and company letters are written in reverse together

parts.note: ER, Elizabeth Regina, is the royal cipher of the Queen

explanation.surface: Gossip holds back the queen and her court from a royal father.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' reverses the queen and company letters together, giving OCRE, which 'holding' places inside the chatter word.
explanation.definitionFit: To sire is to father offspring, so to beget or produce young.

clue.text: First-class teachers rejected outside one's country

indicators.note: outside says the reversed letters go round the letters for one's
rejected says the first-class and teachers letters are turned back together

parts.note: A1 means first-class, written AI
NUT is the National Union of Teachers, a British teaching union
one is I, and 's is read as 'is', giving I plus S

explanation.surface: Top teachers are turned away from a nation's borders.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rejected' reverses the first-class and teachers letters together, giving TUNIA; 'outside' wraps that round one's. A1 is British for first-rate.
explanation.definitionFit: Tunisia is a North African nation on the Mediterranean.

clue.text: A couple of unknowns agent disposed of in Asian river

indicators.note: disposed means arranged, so the letters are set out in a new order

parts.note: in algebra y and z are unknown quantities

explanation.surface: Two mysterious figures and an agent are killed in an Asian river.
explanation.walkthrough: 'disposed of' reads as killed but means arranged: YZ and AGENT are rearranged together.
explanation.definitionFit: The Yangtze is the longest river in China and in Asia.
